tasks.label: Board: Flash
args: grep -qsx 1366 /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor || { echo 'No J-Link probe found. Attach it to the Dev Container (on Windows with WSL2: usbipd attach --wsl --busid <BUSID>). See docs/board-bring-up.md, 2. Connect the probe.' >&2; exit 1; }; exec west flash -d build/current --runner jlink

tasks.label: Board: Check probe
args: grep -qsx 1366 /sys/bus/usb/devices/*/idVendor || { echo 'No J-Link probe found. Attach it to the Dev Container (on Windows with WSL2: usbipd attach --wsl --busid <BUSID>). See docs/board-bring-up.md, 2. Connect the probe.' >&2; exit 1; }
